cast.title: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
cast.original_title: The Flintstones in Viva Rock Vegas
cast.overview: The Flintstones are at it again. The Flintstones and the Rubbles head for Rock Vegas with Fred hoping to court the lovely Wilma. Nothing will stand in the way of love, except for the conniving Chip Rockefeller who is the playboy born in Baysville but who has made it in the cutthroat town of Rock Vegas. Will Fred win Wilma's love?

cast.title: Ice Age
cast.overview: Manny the mammoth, Sid the loquacious sloth, and Diego the sabre-toothed tiger go on a comical quest to return a human baby back to his father, across a world on the brink of an ice age.

cast.title: The Rocker
cast.overview: In the 1980s, a drummer is abandoned by his band just before they become rock superstars. Twenty years later, the drummer sees his second chance at stardom arise when he is asked to perform with his teenage nephew's high school rock band.

cast.title: She Loves Me: Behind the Curtain
cast.original_title: She Loves Me: Behind the Curtain
cast.overview: Step into Maraczek's and tour behind-the-scenes of She Loves Me, including interviews with the cast, crew, and production team. Laura Benanti, Gavin Creel, Jane Krakowski, and Zachary Levi give a peek at what it's like to star in this Tony Award-winning revival. You'll feel like you're in their shoes as you experience the show from their shoes. (Note: Vanilla ice cream not provided!)

cast.title: National Lampoon's Vacation
cast.overview: Clark Griswold is on a quest to take his family to the Walley World theme park for a vacation, but things don't go exactly as planned.

cast.title: Open Season
cast.overview: Boog, a domesticated 900lb. Grizzly bear finds himself stranded in the woods 3 days before Open Season. Forced to rely on Elliot, a fast-talking mule deer, the two form an unlikely friendship and must quickly rally other forest animals if they are to form a rag-tag army against the hunters.

cast.title: Kit Kittredge: An American Girl
cast.overview: The Great Depression hits home for nine year old Kit Kittredge when her dad loses his business and leaves to find work. Oscar nominee Abigail Breslin stars as Kit, leading a splendid cast in the first ever "American Girl" theatrical movie. In order to keep their home, Kit and her mother must take in boarders - paying house - guests who turn out to be full of fascinating stories. When mother's lockbox containing all their money is stolen, Kit's new hobo friend Will is the prime suspect. Kit refuses to believe that Will would steal, and her efforts to sniff out the real story get her and friends into big trouble. The police say the robbery was an inside job, committed by someone they know. So if it wasn't Will, then who did it.

cast.title: Cirque du Freak: The Vampire's Assistant
cast.original_title: Cirque du Freak: The Vampire's Assistant
cast.overview: When Darren Shan is taken to a circus that's chock-full of sideshow oddities, he meets a vampire and receives a life-changing bite on the neck.

cast.title: Alfie
cast.overview: A tale of a philosophical womanizer who is forced to question his seemingly carefree existence.

cast.title: Marci X
cast.overview: Marci Feld, a pampered Jewish-American Princess, doesn’t know about rap or the business world. But everything changes after rapper Dr. S releases a controversial CD for the hard-core hip-hop record label owned by Marci’s father. After a national protest breaks out to boycott the new CD and the record label, her father is hospitalized by a heart attack. Marci decides to step in to save his reputation and the family business by taming the raunchy rapper's wild bad boy image.

cast.title: Go
cast.overview: A supermarket clerk decides to step in for an absent drug dealer, setting off an explosive, comedic chain of events.

cast.title: A Muppets Christmas: Letters to Santa
cast.original_title: A Muppets Christmas: Letters to Santa
cast.overview: When Gonzo forgets to mail three letters to Santa, he convinces Kermit and the gang to help him deliver the notes to the North Pole. Along the way, they discover that Christmas is the time to be with those you care about most, as they dash home to make a friends Christmas wish come true.

cast.title: Mrs. Winterbourne
cast.overview: Connie Doyle is eighteen, pregnant and alone. She accidentally ends up on a train where she meets Hugh Winterbourne and his wife pregnant Patricia. The train wrecks and she wakes up in the hospital to find out that it's been assumed that she's Patricia. Hugh's mother takes her in and she falls in love with Hugh's brother Bill. Just when she thinks everything is going her way, her ex-boyfriend shows up.

cast.title: Open Season 2
cast.overview: After falling head over hooves in love with Giselle, Elliot's road to the altar takes a slight detour when Mr. Weenie is kidnapped by a group of pampered pets determined to return him to his owners.

cast.title: A Christmas Carol
cast.overview: Miser Ebenezer Scrooge is awakened on Christmas Eve by spirits who reveal to him his own miserable existence, what opportunities he wasted in his youth, his current cruelties, and the dire fate that awaits him if he does not change his ways. Scrooge is faced with his own story of growing bitterness and meanness, and must decide what his own future will hold: death or redemption.
cast.character: Ghost of Christmas Past / Streetlamp Lighter

cast.title: Pretty Persuasion
cast.overview: A 15-year-old girl incites chaos among her friends and a media frenzy when she accuses her drama teacher of sexual harassment.

cast.title: Stepping Out
cast.overview: A has-been Broadway performer gives tap lessons to a group of misfits who, through their dance classes, bond and realize what they can achieve.

cast.title: Dance with Me
cast.overview: Young Cuban Rafael just buried his mother, and comes to Houston to meet his father John for the first time. The difficult part is that John doesn't know he is Rafael's father. John runs a dance studio, and everyone prepares for the World Open Dance championship in Las Vegas. It soon becomes clear Rafael is a very good dancer, and Ruby is the biggest hope for the studio at the championship.

cast.title: Your Christmas or Mine 2
cast.overview: They've swapped Christmas – again. Can Hayley and James' relationship survive another turbulent family Christmas or has their future together gone off-piste?!

cast.title: Adult Beginners
cast.overview: A young, hipster entrepreneur crashes and burns on the eve of his company’s big launch. With his entire life in disarray, he leaves Manhattan to move in with his estranged pregnant sister, brother-in-law and three year-old nephew in the suburbs — only to become their manny.  Faced with real responsibility, he may finally have to grow up — but not without some bad behavior first.

cast.title: Mom at Sixteen
cast.overview: Pregnant sixteen year old Jacey's well-meaning mother forces her to keep the birth a secret and decides to raise the baby as her own.

cast.title: When We Were Young
cast.overview: A group of young people in 1959 get ready to set out on their journey to adulthood.

cast.title: Pixels
cast.overview: Video game experts are recruited by the military to fight 1980s-era video game characters who've attacked New York.

cast.title: Just a Walk in the Park
cast.original_title: Just a Walk in the Park
cast.overview: Adam is a dog walker. Adam agrees to watch one of his customers, A.J. Preston, penthouse apartment. Rachel mistakes Adam for Preston. He does not come clean quickly.

cast.title: Henchmen
cast.overview: When a new recruit joins the Union of Evil, he is assigned to a motley crew of blue-collar workers led by fallen henchmen Hank. But when “The Kid” accidentally steals the ultimate weapon, Hank must break his “risk nothing” code to save the boy he’s befriended, even if it means becoming the one thing he has always avoided… being a hero.

cast.title: Big Stone Gap
cast.overview: A story centered on a transitional point in the life of Ave Maria Mulligan, the heart of her community in the Appalachian Mountains of Virginia.

cast.title: CatDog and the Great Parent Mystery
cast.original_title: CatDog and the Great Parent Mystery
cast.overview: CatDog are on a quest to find their parents.

cast.title: Fatal Attraction
cast.overview: A married man's one-night stand comes back to haunt him when that lover begins to stalk him and his family.

cast.title: Mildred and the Dying Parlor
cast.overview: Mildred's parents run a dying parlor out of their home. Today's client is not who she expects.

cast.title: She Loves Me
cast.overview: Amalia and Georg work together at a modest Hungarian perfumerie, and have disliked each other from the very beginning. He thinks she's stuck up, and she thinks he's arrogant and mean. But each rapturously writes to a lonely hearts pen pal when the workday is done, and it doesn't take long for the audience to see that they're in love without realizing it. Originally live-streamed by BroadwayHD, then broadcast as an episode of the PBS series "Great Performances" (season 45, episode 3).

cast.title: No Big Deal
cast.overview: A school takes on a troublesome boy from juvenile hall, in order to try to help him settle back in to normal life. But everything seems to be mounted against him, including a drunken mother.

cast.title: A Christmas Story Live!
cast.overview: A live broadcast of the Broadway hit "A Christmas Story: The Musical" in which Ralphie wishes for nothing more than a Red Rider BB Gun for Christmas.

cast.title: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones: Mystery of the Blues
cast.original_title: The Adventures of Young Indiana Jones: Mystery of the Blues
cast.overview: Going to college and working in a seedy speakeasy bring Indy into contact with jazz great Sidney Bechet, who teaches him how to play the blues. Unfortunately, he also crosses paths with up-and-coming thug Al Capone and it's only with the assistance of his dorm roommate, future Untouchable Eliot Ness, that Indy is able to solve a vicious murder and prevent himself from ending up in a pair of cement overshoes.

cast.title: When Zachary Beaver Came to Town
cast.original_title: When Zachary Beaver Came to Town
cast.overview: Zachary Beaver, a sideshow attraction also known as the world's fattest boy, arrives in the sleepy town of Granger, Texas.

cast.title: Liza Minnelli - Live from Radio City Music Hall
cast.original_title: Liza Minnelli - Live from Radio City Music Hall
cast.overview: Liza's dynamic show made history by breaking the box-office record for Radio City. A true superstar, this all-new extravaganza stars Liza and a host of singers, dancers and musicians, performing a selection of her favorite songs by the world's greatest songwriters. Judy Garland's famous daughter shows of her remarkable voice and spunky dance moves at New York's classiest, most famous venue. Some of the selections include "Live Alone and Like It," "Teach Me Tonight," "There Is a Time," "Quiet Love," "Imagine," and "Theme From New York, New York" (Martin Scorsese's musical, which she starred in with Robert DeNiro.

cast.title: Inside Story: National Lampoon's Vacation
cast.overview: A look at the making of the classic comedy film.

cast.title: The Willoughbys
cast.overview: When the four Willoughby children are abandoned by their selfish parents, they must learn how to adapt their Old-Fashioned values to the contemporary world in order to create something new: The Modern Family.

cast.title: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Reverend
cast.original_title: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Reverend
cast.overview: It's an interactive Kimmy special! Kimmy's getting married, but first she has to foil the Reverend's evil plot. It's your move: What should she do next?

cast.title: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Music: A Live Singing Contest (That's Live)
cast.original_title: Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt: Kimmy vs. the Music: A Live Singing Contest (That's Live)
cast.overview: A live karaoke contest with original Unbreakable Kimmy Schmidt songs, judged by the whole cast and producers! We're talking Ellie Kemper, Tituss Burgess, Jane Krakowski, Daniel Radcliffe, Tina Freaking Fey and more!

cast.title: 30 Rock: A One-Time Special
cast.overview: In a one-time special event featuring all the beloved characters from the original series, Liz Lemon and Jack Donaghy reunite the TGS team to help Kenneth Parcell with an advertiser presentation.

cast.title: My Little Pony: A New Generation
cast.original_title: My Little Pony: A New Generation
cast.overview: Equestria's divided. But a bright-eyed hero believes Earth Ponies, Pegasi and Unicorns should be pals — and, hoof to heart, she’s determined to prove it.

cast.title: Hudson River Blues
cast.overview: Hoping to help their marriage, a Manhattan lawyer (Rya Kihlstedt) brings her burned-out husband (Robert Stanton) to her mother's home upstate.

cast.title: The Man with the Bag
cast.overview: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

cast.title: The 2025 FOX Fall Preview
cast.overview: Jane Lynch and Jane Krakowski host a behind-the-scenes look at FOX's new and returning shows, including "Doc," "Special Forces: World's Toughest Test," "The Floor" and "99 to Beat"; showcasing FOX Sports' weekend lineup.

cast.title: Party Monster: Scratching the Surface
cast.overview: In the probing documentary "Party Monster," DJ Fingablast investigates what became of his childhood hero, DJ Slizzard.

cast.title: Nice Eggs
cast.overview: A young woman comes of age by overcoming a turbulent relationship with her loving but erratic mother, and fights to end a generational cycle of broken relationships to find her own voice.

cast.title: Women & Men 2: In Love There Are No Rules
cast.original_title: Women & Men 2: In Love There Are No Rules
cast.overview: Three short stories about women & men relationship.
